Hydroponics Monitoring

Bringing seven sensors onto one board

I designed and tested seven sensor interfaces. For the analog channels, I scaled the voltage to the ESP32-S3 input range and filtered noise before sampling.

HomeGuard

Writing the code that moves the rover

I wrote the STM32 firmware that drives the stepper motors, reads the sensors, and sends telemetry. I used both bare-metal C and FreeRTOS to organize the rover’s work.

DropLock

Taking a five-person build to a live demo

I led the team and built the booking API, dashboard, and tablet session controls. For the demonstration, we followed a parcel all the way from a website booking to verified pickup.
